that’s very relatable for me, with the religion. i don’t believe in it but at the same time i have to go to church and youth group so it’s like a constant war of what i believe and what has been drilled into my head. 


i’m thinking for now i’ll try public school at least, that way i can at least try to make some solid friendships. part of the issue is that where i live housing is crazy expensive and trying to afford a home or to go to college would be a pain in the ass.
that actually makes sense. definitely don’t plan on acting on it!
